settings.headline: Built for people who want their work to count.
settings.lead: Groundwork lists remote and hybrid roles at climate tech companies, with a salary range on every listing and no recruiter spam.

settings.content:
What we list

Roles at companies whose core product cuts or removes emissions: clean power and storage, grid software, carbon removal, low-carbon materials and food, electrified buildings and transport, and the data tools that measure all of it.

Our rules for listings

  • A real salary range. Every listing shows a minimum and maximum, in the currency the role is paid in.
  • An honest location. Remote, hybrid or on-site, with the countries, time zones or cities that apply.
  • An expiry date. Listings close automatically, so you never apply to a role that was filled months ago.
  • Apply on the company's site. We link straight to the employer's own application page. We never sit between you and the hiring team.

For developers

Every job page includes JobPosting structured data, so listings can appear in Google's job search. The full board is also available as an RSS feed and a JSON Feed.

items.question: Is Groundwork free for job seekers?
items.answer: Yes. Browsing, searching, feeds and applying are all free, and you never need an account to apply.

items.question: How do filters work?
items.answer: Every filter is a URL parameter, such as /jobs?category=data&type=remote&salary=130000. Bookmark or share any search.

items.question: What is the Members' Hub?
items.answer: A members-only page with salary benchmarks by category and curated saved searches, calculated live from the board.

items.question: Are these real companies?
items.answer: No. Groundwork is a demo site built with Raytha CMS. Every company, job and logo is fictional.
